title: 426 Upgrade Required
description:
RFC 9110 §15.5.22; class client_error; engine use: conditional.
Trigger: The profile requires TLS 1.3 or a protocol upgrade before the request can proceed.
Content: application/problem+json (ErrorEnvelope).
Required headers: Upgrade.
Cache-Control: no-store; retry: never.

x-response-contract.trigger: The profile requires TLS 1.3 or a protocol upgrade before the request can proceed.

Upgrade.value: websocket for 101; the required protocol token for 426.
Upgrade.notes: Must name a protocol the server is willing to switch to.

examples.title: Upgrade Required
examples.detail: The profile requires TLS 1.3 or a protocol upgrade before the request can proceed.
